主要内容: On February 26, 2015, Insperity, Inc. announced that the board of directors had extended the deadline for stockholders to nominate directors to the board and propose other business for consideration at the 2015 annual meeting. The deadline was extended from February 27, 2015, to March 13, 2015. Any director nominations or proposals received by the company at or prior to the close of business on March 13, 2015, and otherwise complying with the company’s bylaws, may be submitted to stockholders at the 2015 annual meeting. This change was made pursuant to the company’s bylaws.
